fusions.name: Spore Bloom
fusions.desc: Vents a cloud of ink and spores, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Rot Dart
fusions.desc: Flicks a spore-crusted arm tip that deals 3 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Perched Sporeling
fusions.desc: A bonded sporeling grows on one of your arms and fights beside you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a tick for 4 ticks.
